The strict title counts the other two slices (R-185-BR1 92, R-185-BR2 61) as NOT-RUN; merge the counts if the seat files one record. This slice alone: **142/142 judged · 127 PASS / 9 PARTIAL / 6 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN**. Of the 6 FAILs, 4 are canonical withheld security rows (all probe findings beside clauses whose clauses all passed, all pre-existing at 18.4.0, all ruled by the seat), 1 is an assertion defect (stale clause), 1 is a low P2 product defect. **No P0 in this slice, no regression versus 18.4.0, no data loss, no customer item.**

## Environment fingerprint

- framework objectstack-ai/objectstack **main @ a557fa386bc3** (`pm-dispatch: one checklist card per reviewed PR …` #33731); `ui/` in the same tree, **no Console build** (every item is api / cli / build surface; one browser half of `platform-core.metadata-registry-serving` acc[6] recorded blocked(environment) for that reason).
- Wave: qa#3 seat #33014, anchor #33761 (v18.5.0 release sweep round 1), order `ORDER-2-API.md`.
- Build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (21 s) + `OS_SKIP_DTS=1 turbo build` of the showcase, CLI and dogfood closures (70 packages, 1 m 22 s, 0 cached), then `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (1 m 07 s) so the tombstones tsc pin runs (it did: 10/0, no TS7016). Node 22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0, 4 CPUs, 15 GiB memory cgroup. A second worktree at **181ad7d4 (18.4.0)** was built for regression checks.
- App: stock showcase via `OS_PORT=P objectstack dev --seed-admin -p P -d file:/tmp/qa185/GROUP/db/ITEM.db --no-compile --no-watch`, ports 41150–41199 split per runner group (one server per runner at a time). Scratch app copies (WS layout, `packages` + `node_modules` symlinked to the tree) for every CLI item that writes files, every package install, every self-pinging connector / external-datasource boot and every boot needing its own compile. The tree's showcase `dist/` was never recompiled and its `.objectstack/installed-packages/` was never written (checked by every runner; `git status` clean at the end).
- Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) + showcase demo personas; runtime personas minted per item via `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` + change-password, keys / positions / permission sets via HTTP doors (named per clause).
- Execution: **parallel**, 8 runner subagents (opus, effort `high`, at most 3 at a time) dispatched from this runner thread: L1–L4 Tier 1 pinned items by area, T2A/T2B/T2C Tier 2 unpinned P1, T3 unpinned P2 (all 18 driven, every item in the slice was touched).
- Wall-clock: setup 5 min (09:38–09:43Z) · testing 2 h 00 min (09:43–11:43Z, runners' own setup included, ≈ 6–25 min each) · assembly 10 min. Cost at draft time: `get_session` `external_metadata.usage.cost_usd` = 109.09 (subagents included).
- Environment incidents: the shared memory cgroup OOM-killed two multi-test runs (one dogfood file in L1, one container kill ≈ 09:57Z); each was re-run green. No test failed.

Selector `touched:181ad7d4` resolved at a557fa38 by `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs touched:181ad7d4 --json` → 307 runnable items (8 blocked hidden; 1714 files changed), minus the 24 `priority:P0` items (record R-P0) = 295, of which this slice is the 142 api / cli / build items in `items-API.md`. Each clause was scored at the layer its pin reaches (RUNNER rule 6); clauses whose oracle sits below the pin were driven live or recorded partial/blocked. Tier 2 (35 unpinned P1) and Tier 3 (18 unpinned P2) were driven live, every acceptance and negative clause. Clause totals over the slice: **1,079 pass · 6 fail · 4 blocked · 2 skipped · 9 partial**.

### Reproduction rule · cli.validate-v18-authoring-verdicts · acc[3]

Scratch copy of `examples/app-todo` at a557fa38, CLI from the tree. In `objectstack.config.ts`, inside `defineStack({...})` (strict default), add `todo_qa_hdr` (sharingModel private) and `todo_qa_line` (sharingModel `controlled_by_parent`, one field `hdr: { type: 'master_detail', label: 'Hdr', reference: 'todo_qa_hdr' }`, `required` omitted). `os lint --json` → expected exit ≠ 0 with `relationship/master-detail-required` at error; actual exit 0, `passed: true`, 0 errors. Self-check: importing the config shows `hdr.required === false` already (the strict parse defaults the omission, ruling A of #30905), so no verb sees the omission. Control: the same objects under `defineStack({...}, { strict: false })` → `os lint` exit 1, `error relationship/master-detail-required at objects[2].fields.hdr.required`; `os validate` / `os build` exit 0 — every half of the clause holds on that door only. Reproduced twice. The rev-3 history says the lint exits were read from the rule's reach note and pin, not driven live. Not a regression: nothing in `181ad7d4..HEAD` on `data-model-rules.ts`, `controlled-by-parent-master.ts`, `cli/src/utils/config.ts`; `commands/lint.ts` only 0be91f0e7 (unrelated). Card-185-API-2 asks A (clause names the reachable door) or B (product: lint reads the pre-parse config).

### Reproduction rule · dashboards.cube-query · neg[2]

Stock showcase at a557fa38, fresh file DB, admin bearer. `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` body `{"cube":"showcase_delivery","measures":[]}` (no dimensions) → expected an entry 400 (nothing to select); actual **500 DATABASE_ERROR**, server log: SQLite syntax error near "FROM" (the strategy emits `SELECT  FROM`). Control: the same body with one dimension → 200. Mechanism: `packages/spec/src/data/analytics.zod.ts:982` `measures: z.array(z.string())` has no minimum and no dimensions-or-measures refinement; `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts:1635` builds the empty select list. Reproduced on two fresh boots. Identical code at 181ad7d4 → pre-existing, not a regression.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 4 h of probe time summed over the eight runners (≈ 20–50 min each), on the same boots as the clauses, as admin, baseline member, contributor / client_liaison / position members, Mei and Ada, the auditor, osk_ API keys, an AI service account, a 2FA challenge-only client and anonymous. Boundary classes: empty string, missing id, unknown id / name / namespace on every door; wrong verbs; blank, repeated and unknown parameters; scalar and `null` bodies; whitespace ids; the opposite posture (walled `isolated` / `group` boots for org-admin boundaries, strict:false vs strict, federation-free boots); readers outside the asserted scope (cross-persona batch / resume / import, hidden datasets, unreadable objects in search). Found: the four security rows above (seat-ruled; three re-hits of existing advisories, one new) and two product cards — card-185-API-1 (connector descriptor saved active gets no inert-connector audit until a publish/restart) and card-185-API-4 (`os datasource introspect --out` in-tree check is lexical; a symlinked parent writes outside the project — hardening, seat-ruled not security, identical at 181ad7d4).
